entities.summary: Erasmo Salemme is a retired Italian volleyball player and coach. He won three national titles with the Ruini Florence team. He played 231 matches with the Italian national team, winning a gold medal at the 1970 Turin Universiade, a silver at the 1975 Mediterranean Games, and finishing eights at the 1976 Summer Olympics.
